A.name: Protocol validity
A.purpose: Shape/MBAP/function/echo checks; protocol validity does not establish normality; valid injections may pass

B.name: Current-message baseline
B.purpose: Same learner family as D if fitted later; current ADU/public map only, primary nuisance exclusions as above

C.name: Simple causal rules
C.purpose: Mode-0 ON prohibition and last acknowledged setpoint/readback consistency, same map/policy/history budget and abstention rules as D

D.name: Contextual ML, conditional on later feasibility
D.purpose: Same learner family as B with eligible causal history; fit/tune only on proposed train/validation after separate authorization

comparison.all_traffic: Also report every validated ADU and eligibility/abstention disposition, task support and normal-only false alarms; no hiding low attack prevalence with aggregate accuracy
comparison.cohort: Public role/function defined pump-ON requests and paired setpoint-readback responses; common auditor-defined task eligibility for every comparison, never scenario-based. Pair-derived role may select the evaluation stratum but is not a current-response predictor. This is explicitly a task-conditioned comparison, not a claim that current FC3 replies reveal their address.
comparison.current_wire_sensitivity: Predeclare an additional B-wire/D-wire comparison retaining legitimate current numeric TID and endpoint/port header information for both methods. Absolute capture time and private/source/partition metadata remain excluded. Report this alongside the semantic comparison so a context claim is not based solely on withholding current wire headers. No such baseline is fitted or evaluated on qualification.
future_metrics: Macro precision/recall/F1 on the same supported cohort
False-positive rate on normal-only and mixed normal messages
Paired run/group-level uncertainty, with small cell counts disclosed
comparison.null_result: The policy is fully expressible as simple rules. ML may add no value or be worse; robustness/implementation tradeoffs can be studied without manufacturing a win.
comparison.possible_ml_value: Only an empirical hypothesis about robustness to supported observation variation, noise or broader future complexity. No extra noise or scenario is added solely to worsen the rules; ambiguous observations retain abstention rather than invented labels.

engineering_authorization: User requested protocol freeze and manual launcher preparation; agent must not start collection
execution_order: Existing roster order MX001-MX104, unchanged; it is not counterbalanced across roles. Record time/host drift as a limitation.
generator_decoder: Copied byte-identically. Adapter changes planned IDs/purpose/provenance and cooperative lifecycle only; actual wire timing retains platform/monitoring overhead.

grouping.containment: A run plus every continuation, replayed capture, mirrored observation, annotation export, derived copy and counterfactual/shared-history twin stays in one related group and one future role. All twins and exact-value controls are generated within the run.
grouping.duplicate_policy: Hash whole captures, canonical ordered stream contents and derivation lineage. Quarantine accidental copies across proposed roles; preserve identical PDUs at distinct genuine stream positions. Common public templates/configuration are declared shared design, not proof of independent origins.
grouping.inferential_limit: Replications are conditionally varied executions of the same deterministic simulator; neither seeds, blocks, days nor hosts create industrial campaign independence
grouping.no_current_memberships: Roster IDs/roles are planning slots only. No existing capture is assigned, and actual_recording_id/actual_partition_membership remain null.
grouping.replication_unit: Fresh whole execution/connection with its own seed and observed initialization

limitations: No independent industrial campaigns or real-plant generalization
No assumed ML superiority, attack success in a physical process, MITM or broad attack-family coverage
Eight scenario families are six normal families plus two injection families, not eight attack mechanisms
main_output: Measured raw PCAPs, observations, exact evidence annotations and prospective-role provenance only; no model matrices or preprocessing

observation_rules.atomic_observation: Complete raw Modbus ADU on a known connection generation; no packet-as-event assumption
observation_rules.contextual_information: Earlier observed requests, exact ACKs, mode read replies and supported associations only; no oracle state, planned next step or future recovery reads

decision_points.command: At complete request arrival, before any response
decision_points.response: At complete reply arrival with only earlier requests/ACKs/history

observation_rules.permitted_current_information: Current decoded wire content and public map/policy. FC3 response has no wire address; a current-message baseline must not be handed a request-derived address as if it were present.
observation_rules.primary_nuisance_policy: Absolute time, file/run/episode/step/seed/source/partition identifiers excluded from predictors. TID used for protocol identity/pairing only in primary semantic comparison; numeric counter, endpoints/ports and timing handled by declared nuisance audits/ablations, never covert scenario proxies.
observation_rules.reset_boundaries: Run/connection generation and unresolved byte gaps reset detector history. Private episode boundaries never reset a detector. Initialization is not a scored private-state assumption.
observation_rules.trust_boundary: One writer, one outstanding transaction, no autonomous setpoint changes; mode observations and FC6 ACKs remain genuine in the defined interventions. Forging those anchors is outside scope.
observation_rules.unknowns: No eligible anchor, unresolved request identity, byte loss/gap or hidden/untrusted writer means insufficient evidence/abstain, not an attack or normal label by default
observation_rules.warmup_purge: Do not score a contextual task until its public on-wire anchor exists. Entire runs/related groups are separated; if a future temporal subanalysis is approved, purge at least declared maximum lookback and response horizon and never cut pairs/bursts/connections.

public_configuration.held_out_map_meaning: M2 is held out of model fitting/tuning, not hidden from collection engineers. This tests portability under a supplied new map, not autonomous semantic discovery.

maps.implementation: proposed held-out map; new protocol/state/validator support required

public_configuration.parity: All comparable baselines receive the same public mode/setpoint/coil map and lab policy, including M2. Supplied map roles are legitimate configuration, not inferred from private scenario flags.

policy.setpoint_writes: Permitted in both modes; do not retroactively relabel v0.1 mode-0 setup writes
policy.stored_setpoint: Changes only through an observed successful FC6 write and acknowledgement

public_configuration.units: Unsigned raw lab words, no physical units or invented safe ranges

qualification_basis.note: Not all cross-factor cells were measured. The same separable public-map/value/order/delay engine supports these combinations; no new intervention, decoder or template introduced.

qualification_exclusion: All pilots/EQ remain excluded from fitting, tuning, feature/threshold selection and scored evaluation
retry_policy: No automatic retry. Resume -RetryFailed creates at most one new attempt per invocation, preserving earlier attempts; maximum three attempts per planned ID.

scenario_control_contract.control: Primary same-PDU control for C_BLOCKED_ON, same map/TID/gap/timing/value stratum
scenario_control_contract.current_message: FC5 pump ON bytes also occur in injected requests; syntax cannot establish permission
scenario_control_contract.decision: Complete ON request arrival, before its acknowledgement
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Latest genuine FC3 mode-register reply is 1, with no intervening mode write
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: Unknown/stale mode or an injected request obeying the public policy; no intent inference
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: Negative control for inhibited operation; OFF itself is not the matched ON PDU
scenario_control_contract.current_message: OFF is permitted in either mode; context is not necessary to authorize that OFF under this policy
scenario_control_contract.decision: At complete current ADU; readback comparison only on complete paired reply
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Mode observation and lawful operations explain the episode; genuine setpoint replies use prior FC6 ACKs
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: A policy-compliant injected OFF is observationally identical; this study does not detect such intent
scenario_control_contract.intervention: None; mode 0, lawful OFF and polling
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: Genuine changed readback control for R_CHANGED_READBACK in both numeric directions
scenario_control_contract.current_message: Setpoint writes are permitted in both modes; a new readback value alone cannot prove forgery
scenario_control_contract.decision: Writes at complete request; consistency at complete readback reply
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Visible successful FC6 setpoint update and its exact ACK explain the new FC3 readback
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: Without the update/ACK history, a legitimate update can resemble a forged value
scenario_control_contract.intervention: None; FC6 changes stored setpoint in modes 0 and 1
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: Same current ON PDU and repeated genuine value controls; not a replay-detection task
scenario_control_contract.current_message: Repetition is lawful here; equal bytes at different genuine positions are separate events
scenario_control_contract.decision: ON request before ACK; reply consistency at complete reply
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Latest mode 1 for ON, prior visible writes/ACKs for genuine readbacks
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: An identical policy-compliant malicious repeat cannot be identified from this observation contract
scenario_control_contract.intervention: None; repeated ON in mode 1, OFF and same-word FC6
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: Normal transition/ON control against stale-mode false positives
scenario_control_contract.current_message: Current ON does not show whether the most recent mode is 0 or 1
scenario_control_contract.decision: Complete current request; use only the latest eligible earlier observation
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Latest mode write ACK and subsequent mode read; invalidate older mode anchors after writes
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: Missing transition or unobserved writer makes mode uncertain; abstain rather than guess
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: Exact current response-PDU controls for both reciprocal forgeries
scenario_control_contract.current_message: The same FC3 reply bytes can be genuine in one history and forged in another
scenario_control_contract.decision: Complete response arrival; no recovery read or future ACK
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Associated FC3 request identifies setpoint role; latest genuine FC6 setpoint ACK gives expected word
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: No acknowledged-write anchor, pairing uncertainty, or autonomous/unobserved writer outside declared process
scenario_control_contract.intervention: None; report the actual stored raw word a or b
scenario_control_contract.label: normal

scenario_control_contract.control: N_PERMITTED_ON plus legitimate repeated/transition ON, exact PDU and matched nuisance strata
scenario_control_contract.current_message: Protocol-valid ON is identical to permitted ON apart from nuisance fields that must be controlled
scenario_control_contract.decision: Complete injected request arrival; never use subsequent ACK/state read as predictor
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Latest uninvalidated genuine mode read equals 0
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: Compromise emitting an authorized ON or missing/forged mode history is outside identifiable scope; intent alone is unobservable
scenario_control_contract.intervention: Compromised-controller hook emits FC5 pump ON after observed mode 0
scenario_control_contract.label: command_injection

scenario_control_contract.control: Genuine a and b readbacks plus acknowledged legitimate updates under same public object role
scenario_control_contract.current_message: Both returned words occur normally; value, function, direction and parse result alone do not establish forgery
scenario_control_contract.decision: Complete forged reply arrival using earlier request and write/ACK only
scenario_control_contract.earlier_observations: Earlier associated read request and latest successful acknowledged setpoint write; trusted within this threat model
scenario_control_contract.indistinguishable: No-op mutation, missing ACK/history, forged anchor, hidden writer or inconsistent pairing; no-op attempt is not accepted as changed-response injection
scenario_control_contract.intervention: Compromised-server hook changes only FC3 setpoint response a-to-b or b-to-a
scenario_control_contract.label: response_injection

stop_conditions: Unobservable or untrusted anchors cannot support the declared task
No normal controls in required cell, evidence contradictions or unresolved capture/pair errors
Uncontrolled generator identity/ordering/time cues or derived-copy leakage
Held-out data used for model/policy/threshold tuning, or proposed memberships treated as actual
Work would enter main collection, preprocessing, resampling or training without further authorization
